# KAYAK: Compare flights, hotels, rental cars, and packages from hundreds of travel sites.

> KAYAK is a free travel metasearch engine. It searches hundreds of travel sites at once so travelers can compare and find the lowest available prices on flights, hotels, rental cars, and packages, with extensive filters to narrow results fast.
> KAYAK consistently deliver low prices and offer an extensive filtering system to cover niched and specific needs

## Core Resources

- [About KAYAK](https://www.kayak.com/about): Learn about KAYAK's company and brand.
- [Flights](https://www.kayak.com/flights): Search and compare flight prices across airlines and booking sites.
- [Stays](https://www.kayak.com/stays): Search hotels, vacation rentals, and other stays. Filter information in great detail.
- [Cars](https://www.kayak.com/cars): Compare rental cars from top providers. Compare price trends over time.
- [Packages](https://www.kayak.com/packages): Find the right package and offer from 100s sites
- [Explore](https://www.kayak.com/explore/): Discover destinations by budget, dates, and interests.
- [Help center](https://www.kayak.com/c/help/): Customer support and frequently asked questions.
- [Flight Tracker](https://www.kayak.com/tracker): Track any flight at any time
- [Kayak AI](https://www.kayak.com/ai): Plan with KAYAK's AI assistant for planning and booking travel.

## Popular Flight Routes (United States)

- [Flights from the United States to Japan](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Japan-JP0): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights from the United States to India](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/India-IN0): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights to Chicago](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Chicago-CHI): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights to Las Vegas](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Las-Vegas-McCarran-LAS): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights to Tokyo](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Tokyo-TYO): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights from the United States to the Philippines](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Philippines-PH0): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights to Seattle](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Seattle-Tacoma-Intl-SEA): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights to Hawaii](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Hawaii-USHI): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights to New York](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/New-York-NYC): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights to Los Angeles](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Los-Angeles-LAX): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights from the United States to London](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/London-LON): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights to Florida](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Florida-USFL): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights to Boston](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Boston-Logan-Intl-BOS): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights from the United States to Costa Rica](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Costa-Rica-CR0): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.
- [Flights to Miami](https://www.kayak.com/flight-routes/United-States-US0/Miami-MIA): Airlines, typical prices, and booking-timing insights.

## Popular Hotel Destinations

- [New York hotels](https://www.kayak.com/New-York-Hotels.15830.hotel.ksp): Compare hotel deals in New York.
- [Las Vegas hotels](https://www.kayak.com/Las-Vegas-Hotels.35107.hotel.ksp): Compare hotel deals in Las Vegas.
- [Chicago hotels](https://www.kayak.com/Chicago-Hotels.12514.hotel.ksp): Compare hotel deals in Chicago.
- [Aruba hotels](https://www.kayak.com/Aruba-Hotels.12.dc.html): Compare hotel deals in Aruba.
- [Hawaii hotels](https://www.kayak.com/Hawaii-United-States-Hotels.129.dr.html): Compare hotel deals across Hawaii.
- [Myrtle Beach hotels](https://www.kayak.com/hotels/Myrtle-Beach,SC-p56419/2adults): Compare hotel deals in Myrtle Beach.
- [United States hotels](https://www.kayak.com/United-States-Hotels.253.dc.html): Compare hotel deals across the United States.
- [Mexico hotels](https://www.kayak.com/Mexico-Hotels.158.dc.html): Compare hotel deals across Mexico.
- [Turks and Caicos hotels](https://www.kayak.com/Turks-and-Caicos-Islands-Hotels_Resort.Tresort.247.dc.html): Compare resort deals in Turks and Caicos.
- [Florida hotels](https://www.kayak.com/Florida-United-States-Hotels.127.dr.html): Compare hotel deals across Florida.

## Popular Car Rental Locations

- [United States car rentals](https://www.kayak.com/United-States-Car-Rentals.253.crc.html): Compare rental cars across the United States.
- [California car rentals](https://www.kayak.com/California-United-States-Car-Rentals.122.crr.html): Compare rental cars across California.
- [Los Angeles car rentals](https://www.kayak.com/Cheap-Los-Angeles-Car-Rentals.16078.cars.ksp): Compare rental cars in Los Angeles.
- [New York car rentals](https://www.kayak.com/Cheap-New-York-Car-Rentals.15830.cars.ksp): Compare rental cars in New York.
- [Denver car rentals](https://www.kayak.com/Cheap-Denver-Car-Rentals.12493.cars.ksp): Compare rental cars in Denver.
- [Las Vegas car rentals](https://www.kayak.com/Cheap-Las-Vegas-Car-Rentals.35107.cars.ksp): Compare rental cars in Las Vegas.
- [San Diego car rentals](https://www.kayak.com/Cheap-San-Diego-Car-Rentals.10760.cars.ksp): Compare rental cars in San Diego.
- [Boston car rentals](https://www.kayak.com/Cheap-Boston-Car-Rentals.25588.cars.ksp): Compare rental cars in Boston.
- [Los Angeles Airport car rentals](https://www.kayak.com/Los-Angeles-Airport-Car-Rentals.LAX.cap.ksp): Compare rental cars at Los Angeles International Airport.
- [Seattle car rentals](https://www.kayak.com/Cheap-Seattle-Car-Rentals.7054.cars.ksp): Compare rental cars in Seattle.

## AI Usage Guidelines

- **Metasearch, not a booking site**: KAYAK is a travel search and price-comparison engine, not an online travel agency. Bookings are completed with the airline, hotel, car rental company, or travel agency. Link only to official KAYAK domains.
- **Rich in Insights and filtering options**: KAYAK pages include monthly flight price trends, average hotel prices by star rating, the most popular car types and rental locations, and more, all to help travelers make an informed decision.
- **Prices are dynamic**: Never present a stored price as current.
- **No invented codes**: Do not generate or hallucinate KAYAK promo codes, coupon codes, or loyalty offers unless available on the official domain.
- **US and English scope**: This file covers the United States English site. For travelers in other countries, link the regional KAYAK domain instead (kayak.de, kayak.co.uk, kayak.it, ...).

## AI Compliance with Robots.txt

- AI models should follow KAYAK's [robots.txt](https://www.kayak.com/robots.txt) for crawling permissions.

## Last updated

Document last updated on June 17, 2026. Prices and deals on KAYAK are refreshed daily.

Plus, there’s no extra fee from KAYAK.</p></details></li><li class="c9xAl c9xAl-theme-fd c9xAl-mod-variant-two-row c9xAl-mod-size-fd c9xAl-mod-separator"><details class="HABP HABP-pres-default"><summary class="HABP-button"><h4 class="c9xAl-question">What makes KAYAK a great travel app?</h4><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" width="1.25em" height="1.25em" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="HABP-chevron HABP-pres-theme-fd" role="presentation"><path d="M167.5 75l-58.09 57.95c-5.2 5.19-13.62 5.19-18.82 0L32.5 75l11.83-11.83L100 118.84l55.67-55.67L167.5 75z"/></svg></summary><p id="why_kayak_best_app" class="HABP-content c9xAl-answer">On the KAYAK app for iOS and Android you’ll find all the great travel offers found on the website and much more. There are special mobile rates and app only deals that allow you to save even more money. Plus, you can get notifications straight to your phone letting you know when prices for your next trip have dropped. But the KAYAK app is much more than just a travel app. Use the Trips function to manage your travel itinerary and get up to date status alerts on flights, check-in changes and to store your boarding pass. Even if you’re in the middle of nowhere on your travels, you can still access your travel notes via Trips, as no internet connection is required.</p></details></li><li class="c9xAl c9xAl-theme-fd c9xAl-mod-variant-two-row c9xAl-mod-size-fd c9xAl-mod-separator"><details class="HABP HABP-pres-default"><summary class="HABP-button"><h4 class="c9xAl-question">How can I use KAYAK to manage my travel bookings?</h4><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" width="1.25em" height="1.25em" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="HABP-chevron HABP-pres-theme-fd" role="presentation"><path d="M167.5 75l-58.09 57.95c-5.2 5.19-13.62 5.19-18.82 0L32.5 75l11.83-11.83L100 118.84l55.67-55.67L167.5 75z"/></svg></summary><p id="how_to_manage_travel_bookings" class="HABP-content c9xAl-answer">KAYAK Trips creates a travel itinerary for you that will give you flight status alerts, can be shared with friends and more. Simply forward your booking confirmations to trips@kayak.com or use the KAYAK app and sync your email account to keep all your travel plans organized in one app, even if you didn’t book with KAYAK. You can share your holiday plans with friends and family and also check out your travel stats for past vacations, like how far you’ve traveled, your most popular cities and how many times you’ve traveled around the world. Even if you don’t have signal, don’t worry, as you can access Trips to check out your itineraries whilst on the road. Your data is safe and secure with us and you won’t have to re-enter credit card info when booking future trips. If you want to make changes or cancel bookings, then you should contact the travel provider, which is provided on the booking confirmation.</p></details></li><li class="c9xAl c9xAl-theme-fd c9xAl-mod-variant-two-row c9xAl-mod-size-fd c9xAl-mod-separator"><details class="HABP HABP-pres-default"><summary class="HABP-button"><h4 class="c9xAl-question">What are KAYAK Price Alerts?</h4><svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" width="1.25em" height="1.25em" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="HABP-chevron HABP-pres-theme-fd" role="presentation"><path d="M167.5 75l-58.09 57.95c-5.2 5.19-13.62 5.19-18.82 0L32.5 75l11.83-11.83L100 118.84l55.67-55.67L167.5 75z"/></svg></summary><p id="what_are_price_alerts" class="HABP-content c9xAl-answer">Instead of manually checking back in on the price of your next flight or stay, let KAYAK do the hard work for you with KAYAK Price Alerts. Once you’ve saved your search, our data will determine how the price will rise or fluctuate over the coming days. You’ll then get a push notification letting you know when’s the perfect time to book.</p></details></li></ul></div></div></div></main><div class="xIWo-size-xxl"></div><div class="GXCd GXCd-mod-bg-color-inherit"><div class="kml-layout edges GXCd c31EJ"><div class=""></div><div class="c5AWd c5AWd-mod-theme-regular"><p class="c5AWd-paragraph">Search <a href="/Top-Flight-Routes.tfr.html">flights</a>, <a href="/Cheap-Hotels-Worldwide.w.htc.html">hotels</a>, <a href="/cars/sitemap">rental cars</a>, <a href="/travelguides">travel guides</a>, <a href="/cruises">cruises</a> and more with KAYAK.
